message: We're looking for our first two local businesses.
caption: East Coast Social is brand new, and we're starting small on purpose: two local businesses, done properly. If your Facebook page has gone quiet, we'd love to hear from you. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: Post idea for bakeries: what came out of the oven this morning.
caption: One photo, one line, every morning. "Fresh this morning: cinnamon buns, sourdough, date squares." Simple posts like that remind people you're right there. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: Pin a post with your hours, address and phone.
caption: Free tip for local businesses: pin one post to the top of your page with your hours, address and phone number. It's the first thing new customers look for. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: Post idea for restaurants: today's special, one photo.
caption: Your special board is already content. Snap it, post it, done. Regulars love knowing what's on before they come in. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: A quiet page can look like a closed business.
caption: Free tip: if your last post is months old, new customers may wonder if you're still open. Even one short post a week helps. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs
We're not an agency. It's Matthew, in Memramcook, making the posts himself with help from AI tools, and answering his own emails. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: Post idea for B&Bs and inns: the view this morning.
caption: A morning photo from your porch or window, plus what's happening nearby this weekend. It helps people picture their stay. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs

message: Show the people behind the counter.
caption: Free tip: a "meet the team" post, one person and one fun fact, gets people feeling like they already know you before they walk in. ➜ findhotstuff.com/automation/?ref=ecs
